# Webapp Testing

Use this fallback skill for practical browser-level validation workflows.

## Procedure
1. Start or verify target application endpoint.
2. Run smoke interactions across key flows.
3. Capture screenshots/logs/network traces for failures.
4. Summarize defects and reproduction steps.
